question: In a ΔPQR, ∠P : ∠Q : ∠R = 3 ∶ 4 ∶ 8. The shortest side and the longest side of the triangle,
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The ratio of angles **P : Q : R** is **3 : 4 : 8**.

The **smallest ratio** is 3 (Angle P), so the side opposite to it, **QR**, is the **shortest side**.

The **largest ratio** is 8 (Angle R), so the side opposite to it, **PQ**, is the **longest side**.

Thus, the shortest and longest sides are **QR and PQ** respectively.

**∴ The correct answer is QR and PQ.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Ratio of angles ∠P : ∠Q : ∠R = 3 : 4 : 8.

**Formula Used:** Sum of interior angles of a triangle = 180°. In a triangle, the side opposite to the **smallest angle** is the **shortest**, and the side opposite to the **largest angle** is the **longest**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c26a091e32629081ef1e260bfca0a27b2168a85a3b988ca2235e60060d6d2e9d.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the angles be 3x, 4x, and 8x.

⇒ 3x + 4x + 8x = 180°

⇒ 15x = 180°

⇒ x = 180° ÷ 15 = 12°

⇒ ∠P = 3 × 12° = 36°

⇒ ∠Q = 4 × 12° = 48°

⇒ ∠R = 8 × 12° = 96°

⇒ Smallest angle = ∠P (36°) → Opposite side **QR** is the **shortest**.

⇒ Largest angle = ∠R (96°) → Opposite side **PQ** is the **longest**.

**∴ The correct answer is QR and PQ.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Angle-Side Relationship

In any triangle, the side opposite to the larger angle is always longer than the side opposite to the smaller angle.

Sine Rule

The ratio of side lengths to the sine of their opposite angles is constant: a/sin A = b/sin B = c/sin C.

Triangle Inequality

The sum of the lengths of any two sides of a triangle must be greater than the length of the third side.</p
